title: validateApp requires owner; core-shell, billing, reports pass their package.json team (single PR, libs/ is inlined)

summary: validateApp now throws if app.owner is missing. core-shell (platform), billing (payments), reports (insights) pass owner as literals matching the team in their package.json (apps are browser bundles, so they can't read package.json at runtime). Assumptions: shared-contracts lives in mono libs/ and is inlined, so no platformkit change or version bump was needed; one PR (#1) merged, CI and CD green.
